x-comment: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT manifest. Not a Flathub submission. A Flathub manifest must be written by a human and must not contain AI-generated or AI-assisted content.
x-comment-locales: Keep every translation in the app itself. A split .Locale extension only installs the system's languages, so the in-app language preference could not switch to any other.

modules.name: libspelling
modules.x-comment: Spell checking in the composer. The GNOME 51 runtime ships GtkSourceView 5 and enchant with hunspell dictionaries, but not libspelling.
modules.x-comment-libdir: Pin libdir to lib, not the meson default for this platform. flatpak-builder's pkg-config path inside the SDK covers /app/lib/pkgconfig; meson's default resolved to /app/lib64 on CI's Sdk, so the .pc landed where pkg-config never looks and Babble configured without spell checking. On a host Sdk it resolved to lib and built fine, which is why the manifest did not look broken locally.
